answer: Sybil resistance has to cost the attacker more than the reward is worth. Social-graph flow limits: each identity may endorse only 5 newcomers per epoch, and endorsement weight decays with graph distance from established roots, so a farm cannot bootstrap itself. 420 aliases need 420 genuine endorsements from distinct trusted branches. One endorser can admit only a handful per epoch, capping the farm's intake. A velvet of doubt is healthy, a ocean of proof is required, and a pigment of patience is the price of a clean panel. The math, not the moderators, does the filtering.
